type JsonObject = Record<string, unknown>;
type DependencyState = "PRESENT" | "ABSENT" | "BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE";
type SourceDependency = QualifiedSourceRef | TypedAbsent;
type TypedAbsent = Readonly<{
  expectedOwner: string;
  expectedType: string;
  expectedVersion: string;
  reason: string;
  observedAt: string;
}>;
type QualifiedSourceRef = Readonly<{
  state: "PRESENT";
  repository: string;
  objectType: string;
  tenantId: string;
  objectId: string;
  version: string;
  contentHash: string;
  sourceHash: string;
  validity: Readonly<{ observedAt: string; validUntil: string }>;
  readback: Readonly<{ ref: string; observedAt: string }>;
  privacy: Readonly<{ class: "PUBLIC" | "INTERNAL" | "REDACTED" | "RAW_PRIVATE"; redactionReceiptRef: string | null }>;
  review: Readonly<{ state: "NOT_REQUIRED" | "APPROVED" | "BLOCKED"; reviewerRef: string | null; reviewedAt: string | null }>;
  supersedesRef: string | null;
}>;
type SupportPayload<Field extends string> = Readonly<Record<Field, unknown>>;
type SupportEnvelope<Version extends string, Field extends string> = Readonly<{
  contractVersion: Version;
  documentId: string;
  tenantId: string;
  idempotencyKey: string;
  payloadDigest: string;
  observedAt: string;

  readPacketState?: "AVAILABLE" | "BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE";

}>;

  priorDocuments?: readonly Uint8Array[];

  | "SUPPORT_ABSENT_INVALID"

class SupportContractParseError extends Error {
  readonly code: ErrorCode;
  constructor(code: ErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "SupportContractParseError";
    this.code = code;
  }
}

  "contractVersion", "dependencyState", "documentId", "effectMode", "finality",

const STABLE_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]{0,199}$/;
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const SHA256 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const MAX_BYTES = 262_144;
const OPERATIONS_ABSENT = Object.freeze({
  expectedOwner: "CIBOTFLOW/Luzione-API",
  expectedType: "LuzioneOperationsEvidenceLedger",
  expectedVersion: "LuzioneOperationsEvidenceLedger/v3",
  reason: "AWAITING_OPS_CONTRACTS_ASSURE_04",

function fail(code: ErrorCode, message: string): never {
  throw new SupportContractParseError(code, message);
}

function object(value: unknown, label: string): JsonObject {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
    fail("SUPPORT_CLOSED_OBJECT_INVALID", `${label} must be a JSON object.`);
  }
  return value as JsonObject;
}

function exact(value: unknown, fields: readonly string[], label: string): JsonObject {
  const result = object(value, label);
  const actual = Object.keys(result).sort();
  const expected = [...fields].sort();
  if (actual.length !== expected.length || actual.some((key, index) => key !== expected[index])) {
    fail("SUPPORT_CLOSED_OBJECT_INVALID", `${label} field set must be exact.`);
  }
  return result;
}

function stableId(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !STABLE_ID.test(value)) {
    fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must match the original-byte stable identifier grammar.`);
  }
  return value;
}

function uuid(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !UUID.test(value)) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must be a lowercase UUID.`);
  return value;
}

function sha256Value(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !SHA256.test(value)) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must be a lowercase SHA-256 digest.`);
  return value;
}

function timestamp(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(value)) || new Date(value).toISOString() !== value) {
    fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must be an exact UTC ISO-8601 timestamp.`);
  }
  return value;
}

function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || typeof value === "boolean" || typeof value === "string") return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === "number") {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Non-finite JSON numbers are prohibited.");
    return Object.is(value, -0) ? "0" : JSON.stringify(value);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonicalJson).join(",")}]`;
  const record = object(value, "canonical JSON value");
  return `{${Object.keys(record).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonicalJson(record[key])}`).join(",")}}`;
}

function digestValue(value: unknown): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(canonicalJson(value), "utf8").digest("hex");
}

function rawDigest(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
}

function parseJsonBytes(bytes: Uint8Array): unknown {
  if (!(bytes instanceof Uint8Array)) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Support parsers accept only Uint8Array input.");
  if (bytes.byteLength === 0 || bytes.byteLength > MAX_BYTES) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Support document original-byte length is invalid.");
  if (bytes[0] === 0xef && bytes[1] === 0xbb && bytes[2] === 0xbf) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "UTF-8 BOM is prohibited.");
  let text: string;
  try { text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes); }
  catch { fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Invalid UTF-8 is prohibited."); }
  if (text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Unicode BOM is prohibited.");
  scanJsonWithoutDuplicateKeys(text);
  let value: unknown;
  try { value = JSON.parse(text) as unknown; }
  catch { fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Malformed JSON or trailing bytes are prohibited."); }
  rejectUnsafeStrings(value, "document");
  return value;
}

function scanJsonWithoutDuplicateKeys(text: string): void {
  let offset = 0;
  const whitespace = () => { while (/\s/.test(text[offset] ?? "")) offset += 1; };
  const stringToken = (): string => {
    if (text[offset] !== '"') fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Expected a JSON string.");
    const start = offset;
    offset += 1;
    while (offset < text.length) {
      if (text[offset] === "\\") { offset += 2; continue; }
      if (text[offset] === '"') {
        offset += 1;
        try { return JSON.parse(text.slice(start, offset)) as string; }
        catch { fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Invalid JSON string escape."); }
      }
      if (text.charCodeAt(offset) < 0x20) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Raw control characters are prohibited.");
      offset += 1;
    }
    fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Unterminated JSON string.");
  };
  const value = (): void => {
    whitespace();
    const char = text[offset];
    if (char === '"') { stringToken(); return; }
    if (char === "{") {
      offset += 1; whitespace();
      const keys = new Set<string>();
      if (text[offset] === "}") { offset += 1; return; }
      while (true) {
        whitespace(); const key = stringToken();
        if (keys.has(key)) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", `Duplicate JSON key ${key} is prohibited.`);
        keys.add(key); whitespace();
        if (text[offset] !== ":") fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Expected JSON object colon.");
        offset += 1; value(); whitespace();
        if (text[offset] === "}") { offset += 1; return; }
        if (text[offset] !== ",") fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Expected JSON object comma.");
        offset += 1;
      }
    }
    if (char === "[") {
      offset += 1; whitespace();
      if (text[offset] === "]") { offset += 1; return; }
      while (true) {
        value(); whitespace();
        if (text[offset] === "]") { offset += 1; return; }
        if (text[offset] !== ",") fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Expected JSON array comma.");
        offset += 1;
      }
    }
    const tail = text.slice(offset);
    const match = /^(?:true|false|null|-?(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?)/.exec(tail);
    if (!match) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Invalid JSON token.");
    offset += match[0].length;
  };
  value(); whitespace();
  if (offset !== text.length) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", "Trailing JSON bytes are prohibited.");
}

function rejectUnsafeStrings(value: unknown, label: string): void {
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
      const code = value.charCodeAt(index);
      if (code <= 0x1f || (code >= 0x7f && code <= 0x9f)) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", `${label} contains an illegal control character.`);
      if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff) {
        const next = value.charCodeAt(index + 1);
        if (!(next >= 0xdc00 && next <= 0xdfff)) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", `${label} contains an unpaired high surrogate.`);
        index += 1;
      } else if (code >= 0xdc00 && code <= 0xdfff) fail("SUPPORT_BYTE_INVALID", `${label} contains an unpaired low surrogate.`);
    }
    if (/(?:https?|s3|gs):\/\//i.test(value) || /\b(?:bearer\s+[a-z0-9._-]+|api[_-]?key\s*[:=]|password\s*[:=]|private[_-]?key\s*[:=])\b/i.test(value)) {
      fail("SUPPORT_SECRET_OR_PII_INVALID", `${label} contains secret-shaped material.`);
    }
    return;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) { value.forEach((item, index) => rejectUnsafeStrings(item, `${label}[${index}]`)); return; }
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) rejectUnsafeStrings(item, `${label}.${key}`);
  }
}

function validateSchema(value: unknown, schema: JsonObject, label: string): void {
  if ("$ref" in schema) {
    const reference = String(schema.$ref);
    if (reference.endsWith("/StableId")) { stableId(value, label); return; }
    if (reference.endsWith("/Uuid")) { uuid(value, label); return; }
    if (reference.endsWith("/Sha256")) { sha256Value(value, label); return; }
    if (reference.endsWith("/Timestamp")) { timestamp(value, label); return; }
    if (reference.endsWith("/SourceDependency")) { validateSourceDependency(value, label); return; }
    if (reference.endsWith("/QualifiedSourceRef")) {
      validateSourceDependency(value, label);
      if (!(value && typeof value === "object" && (value as JsonObject).state === "PRESENT")) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", `${label} requires a present qualified source.`);
      return;
    }
    if (reference.includes("luzione-core-contracts-v1.schema.json")) { object(value, label); return; }
    fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} uses an unknown schema reference.`);
  }
  if ("oneOf" in schema) {
    let passes = 0;
    for (const candidate of schema.oneOf as JsonObject[]) {
      try { validateSchema(value, candidate, label); passes += 1; } catch {}
    }
    if (passes !== 1) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must match exactly one allowed shape.`);
    return;
  }
  if ("const" in schema && value !== schema.const) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} has a prohibited constant value.`);
  if ("enum" in schema && !(schema.enum as unknown[]).includes(value)) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} has an unsupported enum value.`);
  if (schema.type === "null") { if (value !== null) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must be null.`); return; }
  if (schema.type === "string") {
    if (typeof value !== "string") fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must be a string.`);
    if (typeof schema.minLength === "number" && value.length < schema.minLength) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} is too short.`);
    if (typeof schema.maxLength === "number" && value.length > schema.maxLength) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} is too long.`);
    return;
  }
  if (schema.type === "integer") {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || Number(value) < Number(schema.minimum ?? Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER)) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must be a bounded integer.`);
    return;
  }
  if (schema.type === "array") {
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must be an array.`);
    if (typeof schema.minItems === "number" && value.length < schema.minItems) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} is incomplete.`);
    if (schema.uniqueItems === true && new Set(value.map(canonicalJson)).size !== value.length) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", `${label} must contain unique values.`);
    value.forEach((item, index) => validateSchema(item, schema.items as JsonObject, `${label}[${index}]`));
    return;
  }
  if (schema.type === "object") {
    const fields = schema.required as string[];
    const record = exact(value, fields, label);
    const properties = schema.properties as Record<string, JsonObject>;
    for (const field of fields) validateSchema(record[field], properties[field], `${label}.${field}`);
  }
}

function validateSourceDependency(value: unknown, label: string): asserts value is SourceDependency {
  const record = object(value, label);
  if (record.state === "PRESENT") {
    const source = exact(record, ["contentHash", "objectId", "objectType", "privacy", "readback", "repository", "review", "sourceHash", "state", "supersedesRef", "tenantId", "validity", "version"], label);
    for (const field of ["repository", "objectType", "tenantId", "objectId", "version"] as const) stableId(source[field], `${label}.${field}`);
    sha256Value(source.contentHash, `${label}.contentHash`); sha256Value(source.sourceHash, `${label}.sourceHash`);
    const validity = exact(source.validity, ["observedAt", "validUntil"], `${label}.validity`);
    const observedAt = timestamp(validity.observedAt, `${label}.validity.observedAt`);
    const validUntil = timestamp(validity.validUntil, `${label}.validity.validUntil`);
    if (Date.parse(validUntil) <= Date.parse(observedAt)) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", `${label} validity must advance.`);
    const readback = exact(source.readback, ["observedAt", "ref"], `${label}.readback`);
    stableId(readback.ref, `${label}.readback.ref`); timestamp(readback.observedAt, `${label}.readback.observedAt`);
    const privacy = exact(source.privacy, ["class", "redactionReceiptRef"], `${label}.privacy`);
    if (!["PUBLIC", "INTERNAL", "REDACTED", "RAW_PRIVATE"].includes(String(privacy.class))) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", `${label}.privacy.class is invalid.`);
    if (privacy.redactionReceiptRef !== null) stableId(privacy.redactionReceiptRef, `${label}.privacy.redactionReceiptRef`);
    if (privacy.class === "RAW_PRIVATE" && privacy.redactionReceiptRef !== null) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", `${label} RAW_PRIVATE source cannot claim redaction.`);
    const review = exact(source.review, ["reviewedAt", "reviewerRef", "state"], `${label}.review`);
    if (!["NOT_REQUIRED", "APPROVED", "BLOCKED"].includes(String(review.state))) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", `${label}.review.state is invalid.`);
    if (review.reviewerRef !== null) stableId(review.reviewerRef, `${label}.review.reviewerRef`);
    if (review.reviewedAt !== null) timestamp(review.reviewedAt, `${label}.review.reviewedAt`);
    if (review.state === "APPROVED" && (review.reviewerRef === null || review.reviewedAt === null)) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", `${label} approved review requires exact reviewer evidence.`);
    if (source.supersedesRef !== null) stableId(source.supersedesRef, `${label}.supersedesRef`);
    return;
  }
  const absent = exact(record, ["expectedOwner", "expectedType", "expectedVersion", "observedAt", "reason"], label);
  for (const field of ["expectedOwner", "expectedType", "expectedVersion", "reason"] as const) stableId(absent[field], `${label}.${field}`);
  timestamp(absent.observedAt, `${label}.observedAt`);
}

function collectDependencies(value: unknown, result: SourceDependency[] = []): SourceDependency[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) { value.forEach((item) => collectDependencies(item, result)); return result; }
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return result;
  const record = value as JsonObject;
  if (record.state === "PRESENT" || ("expectedOwner" in record && "expectedType" in record && "expectedVersion" in record)) {
    validateSourceDependency(record, "sourceDependency"); result.push(record as SourceDependency); return result;
  }
  Object.values(record).forEach((item) => collectDependencies(item, result));
  return result;
}

function validateDependencyGraph(document: JsonObject): void {
  const tenantId = String(document.tenantId);
  const dependencies = collectDependencies(document.payload);
  const present = dependencies.filter((item): item is QualifiedSourceRef => "state" in item);
  const absent = dependencies.filter((item): item is TypedAbsent => !("state" in item));
  if (present.some((item) => item.tenantId !== tenantId)) fail("SUPPORT_TENANT_INVALID", "Every qualified source must match the document tenant.");
  const sourceIdentities = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const item of present) {
    const key = `${item.repository}|${item.objectType}|${item.objectId}|${item.version}`;
    const exactIdentity = `${item.contentHash}|${item.sourceHash}`;
    const priorIdentity = sourceIdentities.get(key);
    if (priorIdentity !== undefined && priorIdentity !== exactIdentity) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", "One qualified identity cannot resolve to conflicting source bytes.");
    sourceIdentities.set(key, exactIdentity);
  }
  const byId = new Map(present.map((item) => [item.objectId, item]));
  const superseded = new Set<string>();
  for (const item of present) {
    if (item.supersedesRef !== null) {
      if (superseded.has(item.supersedesRef)) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Qualified source supersession fork is prohibited.");
      superseded.add(item.supersedesRef);
      const seen = new Set([item.objectId]); let cursor: QualifiedSourceRef | undefined = item;
      while (cursor?.supersedesRef) {
        if (seen.has(cursor.supersedesRef)) fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Qualified source supersession cycle is prohibited.");
        seen.add(cursor.supersedesRef); cursor = byId.get(cursor.supersedesRef);
      }
    }
  }
  const dependencyState = String(document.dependencyState);
  if (absent.length > 0 && dependencyState !== "BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE") fail("SUPPORT_DEPENDENCY_INVALID", "Typed ABSENT dependencies must block the document.");
  if (absent.length === 0 && dependencyState !== "PRESENT") fail("SUPPORT_DEPENDENCY_INVALID", "A complete dependency set must be PRESENT.");
  if ("readPacketState" in document) {
    const expected = dependencyState === "PRESENT" ? "AVAILABLE" : "BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE";
    if (document.readPacketState !== expected) fail("SUPPORT_DEPENDENCY_INVALID", "Read packet state must mirror dependency completeness.");
  }
}

function validatePriorSet(document: JsonObject, bytes: Uint8Array, context?: SupportParseContext): void {
  const prior = (context?.priorDocuments ?? []).map((item) => decodeEnvelope(item));
  const sameId = prior.find((item) => item.document.documentId === document.documentId);
  if (sameId && sameId.rawHash !== rawDigest(bytes)) fail("SUPPORT_REPLAY_CONFLICT", "Changed documentId reuse conflicts.");
  const sameKey = prior.find((item) => item.document.tenantId === document.tenantId && item.document.contractVersion === document.contractVersion && item.document.idempotencyKey === document.idempotencyKey);
  if (sameKey && sameKey.rawHash !== rawDigest(bytes)) fail("SUPPORT_REPLAY_CONFLICT", "Changed P110 idempotency-key reuse conflicts.");
  if (document.supersedesDocumentId !== null) {
    if (document.supersedesDocumentId === document.documentId) fail("SUPPORT_SUPERSESSION_INVALID", "A document cannot supersede itself.");
    const predecessor = prior.find((item) => item.document.documentId === document.supersedesDocumentId)?.document;
    if (!predecessor) fail("SUPPORT_SUPERSESSION_INVALID", "Supersession requires an existing prior document.");
    if (predecessor.tenantId !== document.tenantId || predecessor.contractVersion !== document.contractVersion) fail("SUPPORT_SUPERSESSION_INVALID", "Supersession must retain tenant and contract family.");
    if (Date.parse(String(document.observedAt)) <= Date.parse(String(predecessor.observedAt))) fail("SUPPORT_SUPERSESSION_INVALID", "Supersession must be observed later.");
    const forks = prior.filter((item) => item.document.supersedesDocumentId === document.supersedesDocumentId);
    if (forks.length > 0) fail("SUPPORT_SUPERSESSION_INVALID", "A superseded document may have only one successor head.");
    const byId = new Map(prior.map((item) => [String(item.document.documentId), item.document]));
    const seen = new Set([String(document.documentId)]); let cursor: JsonObject | undefined = predecessor;
    while (cursor) {
      const id = String(cursor.documentId);
      if (seen.has(id)) fail("SUPPORT_SUPERSESSION_INVALID", "Document supersession cycle is prohibited.");
      seen.add(id);
      const nextDocumentId: unknown = cursor.supersedesDocumentId;
      if (nextDocumentId !== null && seen.has(String(nextDocumentId))) fail("SUPPORT_SUPERSESSION_INVALID", "Document supersession cycle is prohibited.");
      cursor = nextDocumentId === null ? undefined : byId.get(String(nextDocumentId));
    }
  }
}

function decodeEnvelope(bytes: Uint8Array): { document: JsonObject; rawHash: string } {
  return { document: object(parseJsonBytes(bytes), "document"), rawHash: rawDigest(bytes) };
}

function isAbsent(value: unknown): value is TypedAbsent {
  return Boolean(value && typeof value === "object" && !("state" in (value as JsonObject)) && "expectedOwner" in (value as JsonObject));
}

function assertOperationsAbsent(value: unknown, label: string): void {
  if (!isAbsent(value)) fail("SUPPORT_DEPENDENCY_INVALID", `${label} must remain typed ABSENT.`);
  for (const [key, expected] of Object.entries(OPERATIONS_ABSENT)) {
    if (value[key as keyof TypedAbsent] !== expected) fail("SUPPORT_DEPENDENCY_INVALID", `${label} must remain AWAITING_OPS_CONTRACTS_ASSURE_04.`);
  }
}

function validateSemantic(contractVersion: string, payload: JsonObject, document: JsonObject): void {
  if (contractVersion === "SupportRedactionReceipt/v1") {
    if (payload.result === "PASS" && isAbsent(payload.sourceRef)) fail("SUPPORT_DEPENDENCY_INVALID", "Redaction PASS requires a present source.");
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportPrivacyRetentionRef/v1" && Date.parse(String(payload.retainUntil)) <= Date.parse(String(document.observedAt))) {
    fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", "Retention must extend beyond observation time.");
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportDataDispositionReceipt/v1" && payload.remoteFinality === "SOURCE_CONFIRMED") {
    if (payload.localDisposition !== "ERASED_LOCAL_ONLY" || payload.legalHoldState !== "CLEARED" || (payload.residualCopyRefs as unknown[]).length > 0 || collectDependencies(payload.sourceDispositionReadbacks).some(isAbsent)) {
      fail("SUPPORT_FINALITY_INVALID", "Remote disposition finality requires complete source-owned readback and zero residual copies.");
    }
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportPolicyEntitlementRef/v1" && Date.parse(String(payload.validUntil)) <= Date.parse(String(payload.validFrom))) {
    fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", "Policy validity must advance.");
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportSlaScheduleEvent/v1") {
    if (Date.parse(String(payload.dueAt)) < Date.parse(String(payload.eventObservedAt))) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", "SLA due time cannot predate observation.");
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportOwnershipAcceptanceEvidence/v1") assertOperationsAbsent(payload.acceptedHumanAuthorityRef, "acceptedHumanAuthorityRef");
  if (contractVersion === "SupportRosterCoverageReadPacket/v1") assertOperationsAbsent(payload.humanAuthorityRef, "humanAuthorityRef");
  if (contractVersion === "SupportCaseIncidentBinding/v1") {
    assertOperationsAbsent(payload.humanAcknowledgementRef, "humanAcknowledgementRef");
    assertOperationsAbsent(payload.recoverySourceRef, "recoverySourceRef");
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportIncidentEscalationReadPacket/v1") {
    assertOperationsAbsent(payload.p111RecoveryRef, "p111RecoveryRef");
    assertOperationsAbsent(payload.incidentRecoverySourceRef, "incidentRecoverySourceRef");
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportClosureEvidence/v1") {
    const choices = [payload.verifiedReplyRef, payload.humanNoReplyExceptionRef].filter((item) => item !== null);
    if (choices.length !== 1) fail("SUPPORT_FINALITY_INVALID", "Closure requires exactly one verified reply or current-human exception path.");
    if (payload.closureState === "READY_FOR_OWNER_COMMIT" && collectDependencies(payload).some(isAbsent)) fail("SUPPORT_FINALITY_INVALID", "Incomplete closure evidence cannot become ready.");
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportReopenEvidence/v1") {
    if (payload.priorCaseVersion === payload.newCaseVersion) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", "Reopen must advance the case version.");
    if (payload.closureWatermark === payload.inboundWatermark) fail("SUPPORT_SEMANTIC_INVALID", "Reopen requires a new inbound watermark.");
  }
  if (contractVersion.endsWith("ReadPacket/v1")) {
    const derived = payload.derivedStatus ?? payload.derivedCoverage;
    const expected = document.dependencyState === "PRESENT" ? (contractVersion === "SupportRosterCoverageReadPacket/v1" ? "COVERED" : "AVAILABLE") : "BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE";
    if (derived !== expected) fail("SUPPORT_DEPENDENCY_INVALID", "Derived read state cannot exceed dependency evidence.");
  }
  if (contractVersion === "SupportOutputHandoff/v1") validateOutputHandoff(payload, document);
}

function validateOutputHandoff(payload: JsonObject, document: JsonObject): void {
  const bundle = object(payload.evidence_bundle, "supportOutput.evidence_bundle");
  const supportCase = parseSupportCaseV1(bundle.caseSnapshot) as SupportCaseV1;
  const action = parseSupportActionV1(payload.proposed_SupportAction, supportCase) as SupportActionV1;
  const reply = parseCustomerReplyV1(payload.draft_CustomerReply, supportCase, action) as CustomerReplyV1;
  if (supportCase.tenantId !== document.tenantId || action.tenantId !== document.tenantId || reply.tenantId !== document.tenantId) fail("SUPPORT_TENANT_INVALID", "Support output documents must share one tenant.");
  if (action.status !== "PROPOSED" || action.effectMode !== "NO_EFFECT" || action.finality !== "NOT_FINAL" || action.reservation.state !== "NOT_RESERVED_G0" || action.resultReadbackRef !== null) fail("SUPPORT_FINALITY_INVALID", "Support output action must remain an unreserved NO_EFFECT proposal.");
  if (reply.delivery.state !== "DRAFT" || reply.finality !== "NOT_FINAL" || reply.reservation.state !== "NOT_RESERVED_G0") fail("SUPPORT_FINALITY_INVALID", "Support output reply must remain an undelivered draft.");
  if (reply.delivery.deliveredAt !== null || reply.delivery.providerReceiptRef !== null || reply.delivery.readbackRef !== null) fail("SUPPORT_FINALITY_INVALID", "A draft reply cannot carry delivery acknowledgement or readback.");
  const recommendation = exact(payload.severity_recommendation, ["authoritative", "sourceRefs", "value"], "supportOutput.severity_recommendation");
  if (recommendation.authoritative !== false) fail("SUPPORT_FINALITY_INVALID", "Severity recommendation cannot be authoritative.");
  const sources = collectDependencies(bundle.qualifiedSourceRefs).filter((item): item is QualifiedSourceRef => "state" in item);
  const sourceIds = new Set(sources.map((item) => item.objectId));
  const nestedRefs = [...new Set([...supportCase.evidenceRefs, ...action.evidenceRefs, ...reply.truthSourceRefs])];
  if (nestedRefs.some((item) => !sourceIds.has(item)) || new Set(sources.filter((item) => nestedRefs.includes(item.objectId)).map((item) => item.objectId)).size !== nestedRefs.length) {
    fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Every Core support evidence reference must resolve one-to-one through the qualified source set.");
  }
}

function validateSourceDocuments(document: JsonObject, context?: SupportParseContext): void {
  if (!context?.sourceDocuments) return;
  const supplied = context.sourceDocuments.map((bytes) => ({ ...decodeEnvelope(bytes), bytes }));
  for (const source of collectDependencies(document.payload).filter((item): item is QualifiedSourceRef => "state" in item)) {
    const match = supplied.filter((item) => item.document.documentId === source.objectId);
    if (match.length !== 1 || match[0].document.tenantId !== source.tenantId || match[0].document.contractVersion !== source.objectType || match[0].document.payloadDigest !== source.contentHash || match[0].rawHash !== source.sourceHash) {
      fail("SUPPORT_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Supplied source bytes must match qualified identity, tenant, type, version and both digests exactly.");
    }
  }
}

function parseDocument(bytes: Uint8Array, expectedVersion: string, context?: SupportParseContext): SupportEnvelope<string, string> {
  const entry = CATALOG.find((candidate) => candidate.id === expectedVersion);
  if (!entry) fail("SUPPORT_VERSION_INVALID", "Unknown support contract version.");
  const parsed = object(parseJsonBytes(bytes), expectedVersion);
  const fields = entry.kind === "READ_PROJECTION" ? READ_PACKET_FIELDS : DOCUMENT_FIELDS;
  const document = exact(parsed, fields, expectedVersion);
  if (document.contractVersion !== expectedVersion) fail("SUPPORT_VERSION_INVALID", `Expected ${expectedVersion}.`);
  uuid(document.documentId, "documentId"); stableId(document.tenantId, "tenantId"); stableId(document.idempotencyKey, "idempotencyKey");
  timestamp(document.observedAt, "observedAt"); sha256Value(document.payloadDigest, "payloadDigest");
  if (document.supersedesDocumentId !== null) uuid(document.supersedesDocumentId, "supersedesDocumentId");
  if (document.effectMode !== "NO_EFFECT" || document.finality !== "NOT_FINAL") fail("SUPPORT_FINALITY_INVALID", "Support v1 documents are NO_EFFECT and NOT_FINAL only.");
  if (!["PRESENT", "ABSENT", "BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE"].includes(String(document.dependencyState))) fail("SUPPORT_DEPENDENCY_INVALID", "Invalid dependencyState.");
  const payload = object(document.payload, "payload");
  validateSchema(payload, entry.payloadSchema as unknown as JsonObject, "payload");
  if (digestValue(payload) !== document.payloadDigest) fail("SUPPORT_REPLAY_CONFLICT", "payloadDigest must bind RFC 8785 canonical payload bytes.");
  validateDependencyGraph(document);
  validatePriorSet(document, bytes, context);
  validateSourceDocuments(document, context);
  validateSemantic(expectedVersion, payload, document);
  return document as SupportEnvelope<string, string>;
}

__PARSER_EXPORTS__
